title: Tamil Nadu Dual Monsoon Rainfall
subject: Geography
caption: Monsoon pathways and rainfall distribution over Tamil Nadu
altText: A white‑background map of Tamil Nadu, India, rendered in a clean educational textbook style. The state's coastline and borders are outlined in thin black lines. A blue curved arrow enters from the Arabian Sea on the western side, labeled 'South‑West monsoon (June‑September)', indicating the path of moisture‑laden winds across the Western Ghats. An orange curved arrow enters from the Bay of Bengal on the eastern side, labeled 'North‑East monsoon (October‑December)', showing the seasonal reversal. Small numeric labels beside each arrow indicate average rainfall contributions (e.g., 30 % for SW, 70 % for NE). Major districts such as Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, and Tirunelveli are marked with gray dots and their names. A legend in the lower‑right corner explains the arrow colors and rainfall percentages. The illustration is high resolution, accurate, and clearly labelled for easy learning.
